senses.gloss:
उक्त उक्त, अस्, आ, अम् (past pass. part.
of rt. वच्), uttered, said, spoken; (अम्), n. word,
sentence; (अम्, आ), n. f. a stanza of four lines with
one syllabic instant, one long or two short syllables
in each; [cf. Zend ukhta.]
—उक्त-त्व, अम्, n. the
being spoken or uttered.
—उक्त-निर्वाह, अस्, m.
maintaining an assertion.
—उक्त-पुंस्क, a (femi-
nine or neuter) word, of which also a masculine is
mentioned or exists, and whose meaning only differs
from that of the masculine by the notion of gender
(e. g. the word गङ्गा is not उक्त-पुंस्क, whereas
the word शोभना is so; cf. भाषित-पुंस्क).
—उक्त-प्रत्युक्त, अम्, n. speech and reply, dis-
course, conversation.
—उक्त-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one
who has spoken.
—उक्त-वर्जम्, ind. except the
cases mentioned.
—उक्त-वाक्य, अस्, आ, अम्, one who
has given an opinion; (अम्), n. a dictum, a decree.
—उक्तानुक्त (˚त-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, spoken and not
spoken.
—उक्तोपसंहार (˚त-उप्˚), अस्, m. any
brief or compendious phrase or description.

उक्ति, इस्, f. sentence, proclamation, speech, expres-
sion, word.
उक्त्वा, ind. having spoken or said.
